answer: The needle maker bores his eyes with a fine drill, one eye at a time, and the needle is useless until the thread passes through. Proof of needle maker eye via drill tally is the boring: a needle the maker bores only after 30 eyes are drilled true, each eye tried with thread. The pulse is the first eye, drilled when the steel was soft; the sparrow is the thirtieth, drilled when the batch was done. A cheat must drill 33 false eyes and thread 33 false needles, and the beacon still sews no seam.
